description:
Return a path-part's own info plus its root-to-leaf ancestry breadcrumb.

Use when you need to resolve a node's type or build a human-readable
path before calling ``read`` or ``cite``. The returned ``ancestry``
list is ordered root → … → parent (excluding the node itself), so the
last element is the immediate parent.

path_part_id.description: Any PDO id — folder, document, section, or chunk.
path_part_id.title: Path Part Id

name: get_info

part_type.description: Node kind, e.g. FOLDER | DOCUMENT | SECTION | CHUNK (the backend's PartType enum also covers DATA_SOURCE, SKILL, EMAIL_THREAD and more).
part_type.title: Part Type

ancestry.description: Root → … → parent, excluding the node itself.
ancestry.title: Ancestry
